create_detection_head_config_with_defaul: create a DetectionHeadConfig instance using all default values for COCO object detection
create_detection_head_config_custom_clas: create a DetectionHeadConfig with a custom number of classes for a different dataset
configure_detection_head_transformer_lay: configure the DetectionHeadConfig transformer decoder layers and feedforward dimension
configure_detection_head_position_embedd: configure the DetectionHeadConfig to use learned position embedding instead of sine
configure_detection_head_hybrid_matching: configure the DetectionHeadConfig hybrid matching query slots and lambda weight
